title: Isolate Dolt root path for checkpoint invocations (stop using/polluting global ~/.dolt)
description: Follow-up from loreweaver-cjs. DoltCli invocations (doltCli.ts) inherit the user's global dolt home (~/.dolt via HOME/USERPROFILE), so the test/checkpoint path reads and writes the user's GLOBAL dolt state: it accumulated ~3000 stale telemetry files in ~/.dolt/eventsData, and dolt's event-flush goroutine makes a network call on commands like 'init'. That global shared state is the prime suspect for the transient 0xc0000005 init crash investigated in loreweaver-cjs, and is also a likely contributor to the dolt-test parallel-load flakiness already noted in beads memory.
design:
VERIFIED against pinned dolt v2.0.3 on Windows 11 (loreweaver-cjs sanity check):

Mechanism (both confirmed empirically):
1. Set DOLT_ROOT_PATH=<isolated managed dir> in the env passed to every dolt execFileSync in DoltCli (run/available/init). Confirmed it relocates BOTH .dolt/config_global.json AND .dolt/eventsData into that dir; the user's real ~/.dolt was left pristine ({} config, 0 events) by isolated invocations.
2. One-time, in that isolated home, run 'dolt config --global --add metrics.disabled true'. Confirmed: with metrics disabled, 0 .devts event files accumulate across init+sql cycles vs 2+ with the default; readback 'config --get metrics.disabled' => true. Because it writes to the ISOLATED root (not ~/.dolt), this does NOT violate the doltCli.ts:60-62 'never mutate the user's GLOBAL dolt config' invariant.

Premise confirmed: the CURRENT un-isolated path writes telemetry to the user's real ~/.dolt — running the checkpoint suite (no isolation) deposited event files into ~/.dolt/eventsData during this investigation.

Extra Windows finding: with metrics enabled, dolt spawns a lingering background event-flush process that holds file handles, causing 'file in use' failures when tests try to rmdir their dolt repos. Disabling metrics avoids spawning it — an additional argument for this change and a likely contributor to Windows test-cleanup/teardown flakiness.

Recommended scope: do BOTH (relocate root + disable metrics). Relocating alone stops global pollution but still spawns the flush process/network call; disabling metrics removes the suspected transient-crash trigger and the lingering-handle teardown problem. The managed dolt home (managedDoltDir) is the natural home for the isolated DOLT_ROOT_PATH.
acceptance_criteria: Dolt invocations no longer read/write the user's global ~/.dolt; no telemetry accumulates there during the test suite; checkpoint suite remains green; global dolt config remains untouched.
notes: REVIEW FIX (commit 35de6d5 on PR #160): ensureDoltRoot() now enforces metrics.disabled on EVERY call. Previously it wrote config_global.json only when absent, so a pre-existing isolated config without metrics.disabled left telemetry enabled. New behavior: read managed config -> set metrics.disabled:true preserving existing keys -> rewrite; missing/empty => {}; invalid/non-object JSON => fail fast with DoltConfigError (no silent overwrite); other fs errors stay best-effort. Added 5 ensureDoltRoot unit tests. Full suite 1233 passed | 3 skipped; npm run check clean; ~/.dolt confirmed untouched. Still narrowly scoped (no repo-storage change, DOLT_DISABLE_EVENT_FLUSH retained).
close_reason: Merged to main via PR #160 (feat(checkpoint): isolate dolt root + disable telemetry), including the review follow-up enforcing metrics.disabled on every ensureDoltRoot call.
